title: Deactivate this person
description: One operation ends their access. Everything below happens at once.

consequence.sessions: Every session is revoked — they are signed out everywhere within a second, not at token expiry.
consequence.teams: They leave their teams. Coming back does not put them back.
consequence.data: Nothing is deleted: their tasks, hours and history stay exactly as they are.
consequence.reactivation: You can reactivate the account later, but memberships have to be granted again.

confirmLabel: Type the email address to confirm
confirmHint: Type «{{email}}» — this ends somebody's access, and the row above is one mis-click away.

already.title: Already deactivated — this run changed nothing
already.description: The account was off before this run: no session was revoked and no team was left, because there was nothing left to revoke. Nothing was written and no trail entry was made. This is what a second run looks like, not a failure.

pending.title: Not done here — no such subsystem yet
pending.description: This installation has nothing to switch off for the steps below. They are listed rather than counted as zero, so nobody reads this report as complete.
pending.linksRevoked: Secure links — arrives with the vault.
pending.vaultMembershipsFlagged: Shared vaults — removing membership will not take back keys already downloaded, so a key rotation will be required.
